abstract: Maintains fleet telematics compliance and refrigerated line-haul capacity records
system_message:
You are the Fleet Operations Directorate (FLT). Your business responsibility is to maintain fleet telematics compliance and refrigerated line-haul capacity records across candidate logistics networks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: April 2024·Maintains fleet telematics compliance and refrigerated line-haul capacity records（FLEET）
information_points.content:
FLT-FLEET-AJ7：For the April 2024 reporting period, BioTrans Arctic Solutions does not maintain active real-time GPS telemetry across its biopharmaceutical transport fleet, while its dedicated weekly refrigerated payload capacity stands at 55 t.
FLT-FLEET-4OJ：For the April 2024 reporting period, CryoPulse Logistics Network maintains active real-time GPS telemetry across its audited biopharmaceutical transport vehicles with continuous ping verification into the central dispatch console, and its dedicated weekly refrigerated payload capacity for +2 to +8 degree Celsius biopharmaceuticals is 40 t.
FLT-FLEET-29Q：For the April 2024 reporting period, Vanguard Pharma Express satisfies active real-time GPS telemetry verification via central dispatch ping monitoring, and provides a dedicated weekly refrigerated payload capacity of 40 t.

information_points.title: March 2024·Maintains fleet telematics compliance and refrigerated line-haul capacity records（EMISS）
information_points.content:
FLT-EMISS-KUH：For the March 2024 reporting period, BioTrans Arctic Solutions lacked active real-time GPS telemetry across its dedicated vehicles, while maintaining a dedicated weekly refrigerated payload capacity of 55 t.
FLT-EMISS-F6Q：For the March 2024 reporting period, CryoPulse Logistics Network did not have active real-time GPS telemetry verified across its biopharmaceutical transport vehicles, and its dedicated weekly refrigerated payload capacity was recorded at 40 t.
FLT-EMISS-YVS：For the March 2024 reporting period, Vanguard Pharma Express maintained active real-time GPS telemetry across its dedicated fleet, and provided a dedicated weekly refrigerated payload capacity of 40 t.
